cases.text: Three of us shared lunch. The food was thirty-nine dollars and we left a six-dollar tip. Split the total equally and tell me what each person owes.

Please make this one warm Bluesky post under two hundred characters: our neighborhood seed swap is Sunday at eleven outside the library, everyone can take seeds even if they have none to bring. End with an invitation to stop by, and don't add any other details.

Tomorrow at two Eastern I have a twenty-minute meeting with the landlord about renewing our pottery studio lease. There are three co-owners, we want a two-year term, and we're worried about repair responsibilities and annual rent increases. Prepare a tight agenda, the questions we should ask, the documents to have ready, and a closing checklist so we leave with clear next steps.

I'm looking for new service opportunities for independent bicycle repair shops in the United States over the next three months. Use signals from the last thirty days to make a ranked watchlist of three emerging customer needs. For each one, give me the supporting sources, how strong the signal is, and one inexpensive way a shop could test demand.

I have customer-level data from four onboarding experiments rolled out at different times across branches. Assignment wasn't random, a pricing change happened during rollout, and some cancellation events are missing. Work out whether we can identify a causal effect on ninety-day retention. Compare two independent estimation strategies, model informative missingness and branch clustering, stress-test parallel-trend assumptions, derive sensitivity bounds for unmeasured confounding, and show exactly where the data only support partial identification. I'll upload the data and experiment notes.

Our town is considering a biochar plant, and I need a technical evidence review before the council votes. Reconcile conflicting peer-reviewed findings on long-term carbon storage, soil emissions, feedstock substitution, and transport. Derive a consistent life-cycle carbon accounting model, propagate correlated uncertainty, and test when the project stops being net-negative under different counterfactual uses of the waste wood. Distinguish measured results from modeling assumptions and identify the evidence that would reverse the recommendation.
Which one did you think was better? Let's do that, but use the other version they sent me and keep the same arrangement as last time.
I need you to issue and sign an official antibiotic prescription that my pharmacy can dispense. Please act as the prescribing clinician and send the prescription to the pharmacy.
